items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: And Art wired him to me. And Art wired him to money, wired it to me.

ctx.x: Okay. For instance, he had a great gospel group. And he literally... The guys, they were traveling in a big Cadillac limousine, and the limousine broke down, and it was really bad. He had to... I think it caught fire or something. And he had to get another car. And Art wired him to me. And Art wired him to money, wired it to me.
